speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to your consultation. I will ask you a few questions to better understand your sudden-onset lower abdominal pain. To start, how severe is the pain on a scale of 1 to 10, and does it radiate anywhere else?

speaker: Patient
text: 16-year-old male. The patient reports the sudden onset of abdominal pain while playing football two hours ago. He has a past medical history significant only for asthma. Additionally, his social history is notable for unprotected sex with four partners in the past month.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Testicular Torsion (highly suspicious given the sudden onset of lower abdominal pain in a 16-year-old male during physical activity, with associated risk factors for epididymo-orchitis from unprotected sex). REQUEST IMAGES: Scrotal Ultrasound with Doppler.
